findings.evidence: RecipeListMapper.kt:13-21 iterates recipe DTO records and maps recipe ID, title, and thumbnail URL. The matched variable 'record' is a recipe row, not a voice recording or voicemail. This code contains no audio capture, user audio data, or transmission of audio.
findings.recommendation: No AUDIO data collection is evidenced here; keep user audio out of recipe data flows and reassess if audio capture or upload is added.
findings.purpose: Local recipe mapping; no audio data collection

findings.evidence: RecipeMapper.kt:79-99 validates YouTube video URLs and extracts a video ID; the matched 'music' text is only the hostname 'music.youtube.com' at line 85. It does not access a user's music files or transmit them.
findings.recommendation: No MUSIC data collection is evidenced here; reassess if the app later accesses or uploads user music files.
findings.purpose: Local recipe metadata mapping; no user music data collection
